sort_by.description:
Sort by options for ambassador insights.

- `created_at`: sort by when the ambassador user is created.
- `num_shared`: sort by the amount of direct shares in the period.
- `num_arrivals`: sort by the amount of arrivals in the period.
- `num_redeems_from_shares`: sort by amount of redeems from shares in the period.
- `rank`: sort by the rank of the ambassador.
sort_by.title: AmbassadorLeaderboardSortBy

user_id.description: Filter on user ID. To keep rank consistent, this will make the user the first result, the limit will be set to 1, total will be set to 1 and next will be set to null, in case the user does not exist, it will return empty and have the total be 0.
user_id.title: User Id
